title: astragalus angustiflorus subsp. hellenicus
intro: Astragalus angustiflorus subsp. hellenicus, commonly known as Greek Astragalus, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against various diseases and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Greek Astragalus include cardiotonic, diuretic, and immunomodulatory effects, making it a valuable natural remedy for cardiovascular health and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Greek Astragalus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions.
